MOTIVATION.context_not_an_occurrence_record: No canonical execution-attempt / STOP-occurrence record type exists in this authority chain or in docs/ops/ods (the ODS 'journal' is the SQL baseline journal-wrapper set, unrelated). None is invented here. The facts below are the motivating context of this amendment only.
MOTIVATION.why_this_delta: The refusal named only the detector and the op. Which allowlisted field class fired could not be determined without reading the value, which is forbidden. This delta makes the refusal name the FIELD CLASS and nothing about the datum.

SAFE_DIAGNOSTIC_CONTRACT.rule: NORMATIVE. When the post-projection supplemental scan refuses a projection (STOP_SECRET_BEARING_FIELD_RETURNED), the refusal MAY carry, per offending location, EXACTLY these keys: operation_id, detector_id, normalized_schema_path, primitive_type, string_length, uppercase_count, lowercase_count, digit_count, underscore_count, hyphen_count, dot_count, slash_count. Bounded to 16 entries per refusal; identical entries are reported once.
must_not_contain: a hostname, userinfo, path or query extracted from the value
a provider record id (unless the reported path itself is id, which names the field, not the datum)
SAFE_DIAGNOSTIC_CONTRACT.path_is_authority_text: normalized_schema_path is the op's own allowlist entry with arrays written [*] (e.g. projects[*].link.repo), a declared presence name, a container prefix of an allowlist entry, '$' for the root, or UNLOCALIZED. A provider key beneath a '.**' subtree is NEVER echoed: such a location reports the '.**' entry itself.
SAFE_DIAGNOSTIC_CONTRACT.counts: Over the decoded value for a string, number, boolean or null; over the serialized container for an object or array location.
SAFE_DIAGNOSTIC_CONTRACT.localization: Structural, not post-hoc. The in-memory projection is re-serialized piece by piece recording the span of every member and value; the rebuilt text must equal JSON.stringify(projection) byte for byte, or every hit is UNLOCALIZED. Each detector offset maps to the innermost span containing it, so key-context detectors (a secret-keyed member) localize to their member, which a per-leaf rescan would not see.

PASS_FAIL_SEMANTICS.rule: NORMATIVE. The diagnostic is OBSERVATIONAL. The decision is the unchanged v1.0.4 check: the same detectors over the same JSON.stringify(projection) text, and any finding refuses. The diagnostic is computed only after that decision, is attached to the same refusal class and the same token, and can never turn STOP into PASS.
PASS_FAIL_SEMANTICS.no_detector_change: OPAQUE_HIGH_ENTROPY and every other detector, its thresholds and its scope are unchanged. No field is exempted.
PASS_FAIL_SEMANTICS.classification_out_of_scope: This amendment does NOT decide that any field is safe or that any detector should ignore it, including when a synthetic Vercel id resembles the hit. The real field class is unknown until the governed runtime is repeated; any exception needs its own evidence-based decision.
